document_name: Aadhaar (e-Aadhaar PDF / Aadhaar letter / PVC card)
document_purpose: Identity and address proof; Aadhaar-based eKYC for scheme enrolment
related_scheme_or_use_case: Many schemes use Aadhaar for eKYC/DBT - confirm in each scheme's guidelines
required_fields: Name; 12-digit Aadhaar number; date of birth or year of birth; gender; address; photograph; QR code
validation_rules: Exactly 12 numeric digits; first digit not 0 or 1; Verhoeff checksum passes; name matches application form; QR code visible and not cropped; document not blurred
common_errors: Typos or spaces in the number; name spelling differs from other documents; outdated address; cropped QR; uploading only one side
expiry_or_validity_rule: Aadhaar number does not expire; address or demographic details may need updating if they change
accepted_format: PDF (e-Aadhaar) or clear image of PVC/letter - confirm exact format and size with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Aadhaar/QR verification via UIDAI resident portal or mAadhaar app
corrective_action: Update demographic details through myAadhaar portal or an Aadhaar enrolment centre; re-download e-Aadhaar after update
notes: UIDAI states Aadhaar is proof of identity, not proof of citizenship or domicile; e-Aadhaar PDF is password protected - confirm current password rule on UIDAI site

document_purpose: Privacy-preserving Aadhaar copy where full number display is not required
related_scheme_or_use_case: Use where a scheme or institution accepts masked Aadhaar - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Name; last 4 digits of Aadhaar visible (first 8 digits masked); photograph; QR code; address if present
validation_rules: First 8 digits masked as XXXX XXXX; last 4 digits numeric; name matches application; QR code present and readable
common_errors: Full Aadhaar uploaded where masked copy was requested; masking done by hand or marker over a scan (underlying digits still readable); masked image with QR cut off
expiry_or_validity_rule: Same as Aadhaar - number does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with issuing authority
official_verification_method: QR/Aadhaar verification via UIDAI resident portal or mAadhaar app
corrective_action: Download masked e-Aadhaar directly from the UIDAI portal instead of editing a scan
notes: Software should flag any 12-digit unmasked number found in OCR text when a masked copy is required

document_purpose: Tax identity; sometimes used as identity or financial reference
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used with income and bank documents; whether accepted as identity proof varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; PAN (10 characters); father's name; date of birth; photograph and signature (physical card)
validation_rules: PAN pattern AAAAA9999A (5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter); 4th character indicates holder type (P = individual); 5th character normally matches first letter of surname; name matches application
common_errors: Letter O vs digit 0 confusion; name differs from Aadhaar; wrong holder type for an individual applicant; blurred card
expiry_or_validity_rule: PAN is generally lifelong - confirm with Income Tax Department
accepted_format: PDF (e-PAN) or clear image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: 'Verify your PAN' service on the Income Tax e-filing portal
corrective_action: Apply for correction through the official PAN services; ensure PAN-Aadhaar linking status is in order as required
notes: Check current PAN-Aadhaar linking requirements on the Income Tax portal before advising users

document_purpose: Identity and address proof
related_scheme_or_use_case: Accepted for identity by many schemes - varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; EPIC number; relative's name; gender; date of birth or age; address; photograph
validation_rules: EPIC number present and format plausible (commonly 3 letters + 7 digits); name matches application; photograph visible; both sides provided where address is needed
common_errors: Older cards with different EPIC formats; address not updated; only front uploaded; name spelling differs
expiry_or_validity_rule: No fixed expiry - confirm with Election Commission of India
accepted_format: PDF (e-EPIC) or clear image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Election Commission of India (through the Electoral Registration Officer)
official_verification_method: Search electoral roll / verify EPIC on the ECI Voters portal
corrective_action: Apply for correction or address change through the ECI Voters portal
notes: Verify the EPIC lookup path on the portal before relying on it in the app

document_purpose: Identity, nationality and address proof
related_scheme_or_use_case: Accepted for identity by many schemes - varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; passport number; date of birth; place of birth; date of issue; date of expiry; photograph; address page
validation_rules: Passport number format plausible (1 letter + 7 digits); expiry date later than application date; name and date of birth match application; photo page and address page both present
common_errors: Expired passport; only photo page uploaded; name order differs from other documents
expiry_or_validity_rule: Has a printed expiry date; adult passports are commonly valid for 10 years - confirm on passport page and Passport Seva
accepted_format: PDF or image of relevant pages - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Passport verification through Passport Seva or the officer receiving the document
corrective_action: Apply for renewal through Passport Seva if expired
notes: Date check can run automatically from the printed expiry date

document_purpose: Proof of annual family income for scholarships and welfare schemes
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; annual family income in figures and words; income source; address; certificate number; date of issue; issuing officer name and signature or digital signature/QR
validation_rules: Income is numeric and positive; figures match words; issue date not in the future; certificate number present; digital signature or QR present; income at or below scheme limit; issue date within the period the scheme accepts
common_errors: Figures and words differ; certificate older than scheme allows; name spelling differs from Aadhaar; income stated for wrong year; unsigned printout
expiry_or_validity_rule: Validity period is stated by the issuer or scheme - varies; confirm on the certificate and scheme guidelines
accepted_format: PDF (digitally signed) - confirm size limit with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Tahsildar office) via Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
official_verification_method: Verify certificate number or QR on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri portal
corrective_action: Apply for a fresh certificate on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri if expired or incorrect
notes: Exact income ceiling and accepted validity differ per scheme - do not hardcode them

document_purpose: Proof of annual family income issued by another state's authority
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; annual income; issue date; certificate or application number; issuing authority; signature/seal or QR
validation_rules: Same numeric/date checks as Karnataka income certificate; issuing authority named; signature or seal present
common_errors: Format differs by state; missing certificate number; old certificate; document in regional language with no translation
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies by state and scheme
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with issuing authority
issuing_authority: State Revenue Department / Tahsildar (varies by state)
official_verification_method: State e-district / revenue portal verification (varies by state)
corrective_action: Obtain certificate from the correct state authority; add translation if the scheme requires
notes: India.gov.in is the national portal; the state-specific portal must be confirmed per case

document_purpose: Income evidence for applicants who file returns
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used where a scheme accepts ITR as income proof - varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; PAN; assessment year; acknowledgement number; date of filing; total income
validation_rules: PAN pattern valid; assessment year matches the year the scheme asks for; acknowledgement number present; name matches application
common_errors: Wrong assessment year; return filed but not verified; PAN mismatch; only a draft uploaded
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to a specific assessment year - check which year the scheme requires
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with scheme portal
official_verification_method: Income Tax e-filing portal (confirm the available ITR verification option)
corrective_action: Download acknowledgement again from the e-filing portal; complete e-verification if pending
notes: Treat ITR contents as sensitive; avoid storing full returns

document_purpose: Salary and TDS evidence for salaried parents or applicants
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used where a scheme accepts salary proof - varies by scheme
required_fields: Employee name and PAN; employer name and TAN; financial year; assessment year; gross salary; tax deducted; Part A and Part B
validation_rules: PAN pattern valid; TAN pattern valid (4 letters, 5 digits, 1 letter); financial year matches the requested year; Part A and Part B both present
common_errors: Only Part B uploaded; wrong financial year; PAN or TAN typo; unsigned copy
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to one financial year
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with scheme portal
official_verification_method: TRACES portal (Income Tax Department)
corrective_action: Ask the employer to reissue Form 16 with both parts
notes: TRACES is the official TDS portal; confirm current verification options

document_purpose: Declaration of income where a certificate is unavailable or a scheme allows declaration
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Declarant name; parent/guardian name; address; declared annual income; purpose; date; place; signature; notary or attestation details if required
validation_rules: Income numeric; date present and not in the future; signature field present; format matches the scheme's prescribed format; attestation present if required
common_errors: Wrong stamp paper or no stamp paper where required; unsigned; no date; income mismatch with other documents
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies by scheme
accepted_format: Scanned PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Declarant; notary or attesting officer where required
official_verification_method: No central verification - depends on the receiving authority
corrective_action: Re-execute on the format and stamp value prescribed by the scheme or state
notes: Whether self-declaration is accepted differs by scheme - always check the scheme guidelines

document_purpose: Proof of Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe status for reservation and scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; caste or tribe name; taluk and village; certificate number; date of issue; issuing officer signature or digital signature/QR
validation_rules: Caste/tribe name present; certificate number present; issue date not in the future; signature or QR present; name matches application; caste name matches the applicant's claimed category
common_errors: Caste spelled differently from the notified list; certificate from another state used for a Karnataka scheme; name mismatch; unsigned copy
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm on the certificate and scheme guidelines
accepted_format: PDF (digitally signed) - confirm size limit with the portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Tahsildar) via Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
official_verification_method: Verify certificate number or QR on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
corrective_action: Apply for correction or fresh issue through Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
notes: Verify whether the scheme needs a caste-only or a combined caste-and-income certificate

document_purpose: Proof of backward class category for state schemes and scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; caste and category (e.g. Category-1, 2A, 3A, 3B as applicable); certificate number; date of issue; issuing officer
validation_rules: Category present and from the state's recognised list; certificate number present; date valid; signature or QR present; name matches application
common_errors: Category not stated; central OBC list confused with state list; wrong category claimed; expired or old copy
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm with issuing authority and scheme
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Tahsildar) via Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
official_verification_method: Verify certificate number or QR on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
corrective_action: Request correction or fresh certificate stating the category
notes: Karnataka state category list and central OBC list differ; the scheme decides which one applies

document_purpose: Proof of OBC non-creamy-layer status for central reservation and some central schemes
related_scheme_or_use_case: Central schemes requiring OBC-NCL - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; caste as in the central OBC list; non-creamy-layer statement; financial year or date; certificate number; issuing authority
validation_rules: Caste appears in the central OBC list; non-creamy-layer statement present; certificate date within the period required; signature or QR present
common_errors: State OBC certificate uploaded instead of central NCL; caste not in central list; certificate too old; missing NCL declaration
expiry_or_validity_rule: Typically valid only for a limited period - confirm on the certificate and scheme guidelines
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department / competent authority notified by the state
official_verification_method: Verification by the issuing state authority; central list reference through National Commission for Backward Classes
corrective_action: Apply for a fresh NCL certificate from the competent authority
notes: Check the NCBC site for the current central list before validating caste names

document_purpose: Proof of EWS eligibility for reservation among unreserved categories
related_scheme_or_use_case: Central EWS reservation and schemes referring to EWS - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; gross annual family income; financial year; statement on assets/land; certificate number; issuing authority and signature
validation_rules: Income present and within the EWS limit set by current government orders; financial year matches the application; signature or QR present; name matches application
common_errors: Certificate for a different financial year; income above limit; missing asset declaration; state format used where central format is required
expiry_or_validity_rule: Commonly valid for the financial year of issue - confirm in the current order and the certificate
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department / competent authority notified by the state
official_verification_method: Verification by the issuing authority; confirm in the current DoPT/state orders
corrective_action: Apply for a fresh certificate for the correct financial year
notes: Eligibility thresholds can change; confirm current orders before applying rules

document_purpose: Proof of Class 10 marks, date of birth and name
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship applications needing Class 10 details; also used for DOB evidence - varies by scheme
required_fields: Student name; parents' names; date of birth; register number; year of examination; subject-wise marks; result; school
validation_rules: Register number present; examination year plausible; name and date of birth match application; result is pass; marks total consistent with subject marks
common_errors: Name differs from Aadhaar; date of birth mismatch; photocopy of a duplicate card; missing register number
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board (KSEAB)
official_verification_method: KSEAB official result or verification service; DigiLocker where available
corrective_action: Apply for a duplicate or correction through KSEAB
notes: Confirm whether DigiLocker access is available for the relevant year

document_purpose: Proof of Class 12 marks and stream
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; register number; stream/combination; year; subject-wise marks; result; college
validation_rules: Register number present; stream stated; result is pass; name matches application; marks total consistent
common_errors: Provisional statement used where final is needed; name mismatch; wrong year; missing stream
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Official DPUE result or verification service
corrective_action: Apply for a duplicate marks card through the Department of Pre-University Education
notes: Other states' boards have different formats - flag board name in the app

document_purpose: Proof of academic performance for continuing or renewal scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; roll or registration number; course; academic year or semester; subject-wise marks or grades; percentage or CGPA; result status; institution
validation_rules: Name matches application; roll number present; result shows pass; percentage meets the scheme's minimum; academic year matches the application
common_errors: Wrong semester uploaded; marks below scheme minimum; result withheld; name mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to a specific academic year
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: University result portal or institute verification (varies)
corrective_action: Obtain a corrected or consolidated marksheet from the institution
notes: Minimum marks rule differs per scheme and course - do not hardcode

document_purpose: Proof that the student is currently enrolled
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; course; year or semester; academic session; institution name; date of issue; principal or registrar signature and seal
validation_rules: Institution name present; academic session matches the application; issue date not in the future and recent; signature and seal present; name matches application
common_errors: No seal; old certificate; wrong academic year; institution name different from application
expiry_or_validity_rule: Typically relevant for the current academic year - confirm with scheme
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Institute nodal officer verification on the scholarship portal (varies by scheme)
corrective_action: Request a fresh certificate from the institution office
notes: Institute verification flow depends on the portal and scheme

document_purpose: Proof of fees paid or payable, used for fee-linked scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; student ID or roll number; institution; academic year; fee heads and amounts; total; payment date and mode; receipt number
validation_rules: Amount numeric and positive; heads sum to total; academic year matches the application; receipt number present; name matches application
common_errors: Tuition and other fees not separated; receipt for another year; handwritten or unstamped receipt; amount differs from the application
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to a specific academic year
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Institute verification (varies by scheme)
corrective_action: Obtain a stamped receipt with fee-head breakdown from the institution
notes: Amount eligible for scholarship is decided by the scheme

document_purpose: Proof of admission or current enrolment
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; course; year of admission; institution name; admission or enrolment number; date; authorised signature or seal
validation_rules: Name matches application; course matches application; institution name present; date present; signature or seal present
common_errors: ID card expired; course not stated; blurred image; name mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: ID cards may carry a printed validity date; otherwise varies
accepted_format: Image or PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Institute verification (varies by scheme)
corrective_action: Request a fresh admission letter or updated ID
notes: Use a bonafide certificate if the scheme demands it instead

document_purpose: Proof of residence in Karnataka for state schemes and admissions
related_scheme_or_use_case: Karnataka schemes requiring residence proof - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; address; period of residence; certificate number; date of issue; issuing officer signature or QR
validation_rules: Address present and in Karnataka; period of residence stated if required; issue date valid; signature or QR present; name matches application
common_errors: Address differs from Aadhaar; period of residence missing; old certificate; unsigned copy
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm on the certificate and scheme guidelines
accepted_format: PDF (digitally signed) - confirm with the portal
issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Tahsildar) via Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
official_verification_method: Verify certificate number or QR on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
corrective_action: Apply for a fresh certificate on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
notes: Confirm the exact certificate name offered by the portal for domicile

document_purpose: Proof of permanent residence or domicile in a given state
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; address; state; period of residence; certificate number; date of issue; issuing authority
validation_rules: State named; certificate number present; date valid; signature or seal present; name matches application
common_errors: Certificate for the wrong state; no residence period; old copy; regional-language document without translation
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies by state and scheme
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with issuing authority
issuing_authority: State Revenue Department / District authority (varies by state)
official_verification_method: State e-district portal verification (varies by state)
corrective_action: Obtain certificate from the correct state authority
notes: National portal only; the state portal must be confirmed per case

document_purpose: Household and address proof; sometimes used as income-category evidence
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Head of family name; family member names; address; card type; card number; issuing office
validation_rules: Card number present; applicant listed as a member; address present; card type stated; name matches application
common_errors: Applicant not listed as a member; card type not clear; address outdated; only part of the card uploaded
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm with issuing authority
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Karnataka
official_verification_method: Ration card status lookup on the department portal
corrective_action: Apply for member addition or correction through the department
notes: Whether a ration card is accepted as address or income proof varies by scheme

document_purpose: Supporting evidence for current address
related_scheme_or_use_case: varies by scheme
required_fields: Name of consumer or tenant; address; bill or agreement date; provider or landlord details
validation_rules: Name matches application; address matches application; date is recent as required; provider name present
common_errors: Bill in another person's name; address differs from Aadhaar; old bill; unregistered agreement where registration is required
expiry_or_validity_rule: Generally depends on a recent date requested by the scheme - varies
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: No central verification - depends on the receiving authority
corrective_action: Provide a recent bill in the applicant's or a family member's name with a relationship declaration if the scheme allows
notes: Acceptance as address proof is scheme-specific

document_purpose: Bank account details for direct benefit transfer
related_scheme_or_use_case: DBT-based scholarships and schemes - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Account holder name; account number; IFSC code; bank and branch name; photograph and signature where printed; passbook page seal
validation_rules: IFSC is 11 characters with 4 letters, a zero in the 5th position, then 6 alphanumeric characters; account number numeric; holder name matches applicant (or parent if allowed by scheme); bank and branch visible
common_errors: Joint account with unclear holder; name differs from Aadhaar; IFSC typo; dormant account; account of someone other than the applicant
expiry_or_validity_rule: No expiry; account must be active
accepted_format: PDF or image of first page - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Penny-drop or account verification through the DBT/payment system (scheme-dependent); branch verification
corrective_action: Request the bank to correct name or open an account in the applicant's name
notes: RBI is the regulator; the issuing authority is the individual bank

document_purpose: Bank account proof with printed account holder details
related_scheme_or_use_case: DBT-based scholarships and schemes where cheque is accepted
required_fields: Account holder name; account number; IFSC; bank and branch; the word CANCELLED written across the cheque
validation_rules: IFSC pattern valid; account number numeric; holder name printed and matches applicant; cancellation marking visible; cheque is not for a different person
common_errors: Cheque without printed name; cheque not cancelled; unreadable MICR or IFSC; blurred image
expiry_or_validity_rule: No expiry; account must be active
accepted_format: Image or PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Account verification through the receiving authority or bank
corrective_action: Use the passbook first page if the cheque has no printed name
notes: Some banks issue cheques without names - the passbook is then the safer proof

document_purpose: Confirm that the bank account can receive direct benefit transfers
related_scheme_or_use_case: DBT-based scholarships and schemes - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Aadhaar number (masked in display); bank name; linking or seeding status; NPCI mapping status where shown
validation_rules: Status text indicates the account is linked or seeded; bank name matches the passbook; date of check present if screenshot; name consistent with other documents
common_errors: Account linked to Aadhaar but not enabled for DBT; Aadhaar linked to a different bank than the one in the form; status screenshot is old
expiry_or_validity_rule: Status can change; re-check close to application date
accepted_format: Screenshot or PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Bank Aadhaar seeding status check on UIDAI resident services; confirmation from the bank (confirm available option)
corrective_action: Ask the bank to seed Aadhaar and enable DBT mapping on the account
notes: Confirm the exact UIDAI service name and NPCI mapper process before showing steps to users

document_name: Test case: name consistency across documents
document_purpose: Check that the applicant's name is consistent across uploaded documents
related_scheme_or_use_case: varies by scheme
required_fields: Name text extracted from each document; application form name
validation_rules: Normalise case, spaces and punctuation; compare each document name with the application name; flag differences in initials, order or spelling for user review; do not auto-reject
common_errors: Initials expanded in one document and not in another; surname and given name swapped; spelling variants; typos in OCR
expiry_or_validity_rule: Not applicable
accepted_format: Not applicable - logic rule
official_verification_method: Final decision by the receiving authority
corrective_action: Show the user the mismatching fields and suggest an affidavit or document correction as the scheme allows
notes: Test case - not an official rule; thresholds are design decisions by the team

document_name: Test case: date and validity logic
document_purpose: Check issue date, expiry date and required period across documents
related_scheme_or_use_case: varies by scheme
required_fields: Issue date; expiry date; application date; required period from the scheme; financial or academic year
validation_rules: Issue date not after application date; expiry date after application date where one exists; certificate age within the scheme's allowed period; year on certificate matches the required year; date of birth matches across documents
common_errors: Date format confusion (DD/MM vs MM/DD); two-digit years; future dates; certificate for the wrong year
expiry_or_validity_rule: Depends on the document and scheme
accepted_format: Not applicable - logic rule
official_verification_method: Final decision by the receiving authority
corrective_action: Tell the user which document date fails and which new document is needed
notes: Test case - not an official rule; allowed periods must be read from each scheme's guidelines

document_name: Test case: file quality and format check
document_purpose: Check that uploaded files are readable and meet the portal's requirements
related_scheme_or_use_case: varies by scheme
required_fields: File type; file size; page count; resolution or legibility; presence of required pages and signatures
validation_rules: File type is among the allowed types; size is within the limit; text is legible by OCR; all required pages present; image not rotated or cropped; password-protected PDFs flagged for the user
common_errors: Oversized files; wrong file type; blurred scans; one page of a multi-page document; locked PDF
expiry_or_validity_rule: Not applicable
accepted_format: Confirm allowed types and size limits with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Portal upload validation
corrective_action: Ask the user to rescan, compress or convert the file as per the portal's current instructions
notes: Test case - portal size and format limits change; read them from the portal each time

document_purpose: Identity and address proof where accepted
related_scheme_or_use_case: Accepted for identity by many schemes - varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; licence number; date of birth; address; photograph; date of issue; validity date; vehicle classes; issuing RTO
validation_rules: Licence number present; validity date later than application date; name and date of birth match application; photograph visible; both sides provided if address is needed
common_errors: Expired licence; learner's licence uploaded as full licence; address differs from Aadhaar; only front side uploaded
expiry_or_validity_rule: Has a printed validity date; varies by licence type - check the card
accepted_format: PDF (DigiLocker/mParivahan) or clear image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: State Transport Authority / Regional Transport Office
official_verification_method: Licence status check on Parivahan Sarathi portal or mParivahan app (confirm current option)
corrective_action: Renew through the Parivahan/RTO services if expired
notes: Learner's licence is generally not accepted as full identity proof - confirm per scheme

document_purpose: Temporary 16-digit number used instead of the Aadhaar number for authentication or masked sharing
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used where an agency accepts VID in place of Aadhaar number - confirm per scheme
required_fields: 16-digit VID; name (from linked Aadhaar); generation date
validation_rules: Exactly 16 numeric digits; must not be confused with 12-digit Aadhaar number; most recent VID replaces older ones; name matches application
common_errors: VID entered in an Aadhaar-number field; old VID after regeneration; typing errors
expiry_or_validity_rule: VID is revocable and can be regenerated by the Aadhaar holder; previous VID stops working - confirm with UIDAI
accepted_format: Number entry; not an uploaded document
official_verification_method: Generated and managed by the Aadhaar holder on the UIDAI portal or mAadhaar app
corrective_action: Generate a new VID through the UIDAI portal or mAadhaar
notes: Software can check length (16 digits) and flag a 12-digit entry as an Aadhaar number

document_purpose: Digitally issued documents (e.g. certificates, marksheets) treated as official copies when issued by the authority
related_scheme_or_use_case: Many schemes accept DigiLocker documents - confirm per scheme
required_fields: Document name; issuer name; issuing date; document URI or reference; user name
validation_rules: Document shows issuer name; reference/URI present; name matches application; document not a user-uploaded scan labelled as issued
common_errors: Uploaded copy of a scan stored in DigiLocker (not issuer-issued); issuer name missing; document revoked at source
expiry_or_validity_rule: As per the underlying document
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Fetched directly from issuer through DigiLocker
corrective_action: Fetch the document again from the issuer section in DigiLocker; contact issuer if missing
notes: Distinguish issued documents from user uploads in the app

document_purpose: Downloadable digital version of the Voter ID
related_scheme_or_use_case: Accepted for identity by many schemes - varies by scheme
required_fields: Name; EPIC number; relative's name; gender; date of birth or age; address; photograph; QR code
validation_rules: EPIC number present; QR present; name matches application; downloaded copy shows full page
common_errors: Cropped QR; address outdated; mismatch with physical card details
expiry_or_validity_rule: No fixed expiry - confirm with Election Commission of India
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with scheme portal
official_verification_method: Verify via the ECI Voters portal
corrective_action: Apply for correction through the ECI Voters portal and download e-EPIC again
notes: Mobile number linked to the electoral record is typically needed to download - confirm on portal

document_purpose: Evidence that PAN is linked with Aadhaar where required
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used where PAN is required to be operative - confirm per scheme
required_fields: PAN; masked Aadhaar number; status message; date of check
validation_rules: PAN pattern valid; status text indicates linked; check date present; name matches application
common_errors: Screenshot is old; PAN is not linked; PAN shown but status missing
expiry_or_validity_rule: Status can change; re-check close to application date
accepted_format: Screenshot or PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Link status check on the Income Tax e-filing portal
corrective_action: Link PAN with Aadhaar through the Income Tax portal if not linked, subject to current rules
notes: Rules and fees for linking change over time - check the portal before advising

document_purpose: Evidence of monthly income from employment
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Employee name; employer name; month and year; gross salary; deductions; net pay; employee ID; employer seal or signature
validation_rules: Month and year present; gross minus deductions equals net; name matches application; employer name present; recent as required
common_errors: Old slips; totals do not add up; no employer details; unsigned slip
expiry_or_validity_rule: Depends on the period requested by the scheme
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Employer verification; no central portal
corrective_action: Request stamped or signed slips from the employer
notes: Salary slip alone may not be accepted as annual income proof

document_purpose: Evidence of land holding and agricultural details used for farmer or rural income context
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Owner name; survey number; extent of land; village and taluk; crop details; date of extract
validation_rules: Survey number present; owner name matches applicant or parent; extract date recent as required; village and taluk match address
common_errors: Land in another family member's name; extract too old; wrong village
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - extract date matters; confirm with scheme
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
official_verification_method: Bhoomi / Karnataka Land Records portal
corrective_action: Download a fresh extract from the land records portal
notes: Confirm the current portal name and path before use

document_purpose: Evidence of pension income
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Pensioner name; PPO number; pension amount; paying authority or bank; date of issue
validation_rules: PPO number present; pension amount numeric; name matches application; authority named
common_errors: Old pension amount; family pension and own pension mixed; missing PPO number
expiry_or_validity_rule: Pension amount can change; use recent proof
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Verification by paying bank or authority
corrective_action: Request a current pension certificate from the bank or authority
notes: Government pensions are managed by different bodies for central and state employees

document_name: CA-certified income certificate / business income declaration
document_purpose: Income evidence for self-employed or business families
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Name of person; business name; period; income figure; Chartered Accountant name and membership number; UDIN; date; signature and seal
validation_rules: Income numeric; period stated; CA membership number present; UDIN present; signature and seal present; name matches application
common_errors: No UDIN; unsigned; income for a different year; CA details missing
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to a stated period
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: UDIN verification on the ICAI portal (confirm current option)
corrective_action: Request a certificate with UDIN from the CA
notes: Check the scheme first - many accept only a government-issued income certificate

document_purpose: Proof of belonging to a notified minority community for minority scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Minority scholarships (e.g. on NSP) - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; community; certificate number; date; issuing authority or declaration signatory
validation_rules: Community name present and among those notified for the scheme; date present; signature present; name matches application
common_errors: Community not stated; wrong format; declaration unsigned; old certificate
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies by scheme
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Competent authority as per state/scheme (confirm); some schemes accept self-declaration
official_verification_method: Verification by receiving authority or institute
corrective_action: Obtain a certificate or fill the prescribed declaration as per the scheme
notes: Whether a certificate or a declaration is required differs by scheme

document_purpose: Proof of SC/ST status issued by another state's authority
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; parent/guardian name; caste or tribe; village and district; state; certificate number; date; issuing officer
validation_rules: Caste/tribe present; state named; certificate number present; date valid; signature or seal present
common_errors: Applying in Karnataka with another state's certificate where the scheme asks for the local certificate; caste not in the local list
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies by state
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with issuing authority
official_verification_method: State e-district portal verification (varies)
corrective_action: Check the scheme rule on migrant status and obtain the local certificate if required
notes: SC/ST lists are state-specific; acceptance depends on the scheme

document_purpose: Validation of a caste claim, needed for admissions or benefits in Maharashtra
related_scheme_or_use_case: Admissions/schemes in Maharashtra - confirm in scheme guidelines
required_fields: Applicant name; caste; validity certificate number; date; issuing Scrutiny Committee
validation_rules: Certificate number present; issuing committee named; name matches application; date present
common_errors: Only a caste certificate uploaded when validity certificate is required; receipt or acknowledgement uploaded instead of final certificate
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm with issuing authority
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
official_verification_method: Verification through the issuing committee or state portal (confirm)
corrective_action: Apply for validity through the Scrutiny Committee
notes: Maharashtra-specific; keep out of Karnataka flows

document_purpose: Supporting evidence where the applicant's own certificate is not yet issued
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Relative name; relationship; caste; certificate number; date; issuing authority
validation_rules: Relationship stated or proven; caste matches the applicant's claim; certificate valid; name of relative matches applicant's parent details
common_errors: Relationship not proven; certificate belongs to a different relative; caste spelling differs
expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Competent authority as per issuing state
official_verification_method: As for the original certificate
corrective_action: Apply for the applicant's own certificate; keep acknowledgement receipt as interim proof where the scheme accepts it
notes: Many schemes need the applicant's own certificate - check first

document_purpose: Proof of completed graduation for higher-education scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Name; degree and discipline; university; year of passing; registration number; class or grade; date of issue
validation_rules: Registration number present; degree name present; year valid; name matches application; signature or seal present
common_errors: Provisional used where final is needed; name mismatch; wrong year; low-quality scan
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: University verification or DigiLocker where available
corrective_action: Request a duplicate or correction from the university
notes: DigiLocker coverage differs by university

document_purpose: Proof of polytechnic or diploma marks
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Name; registration number; programme; semester or year; marks; result; institution
validation_rules: Registration number present; semester stated; result pass; name matches application
common_errors: Back-paper subjects hidden; wrong semester; name mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Department of Technical Education, Karnataka (or relevant board)
official_verification_method: Official result portal or institute verification (confirm)
corrective_action: Request a duplicate from the board
notes: Confirm the correct board for the diploma programme

document_purpose: Proof of leaving previous school or college
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; parents' names; date of birth; class last studied; date of leaving; conduct; TC number; institution; signature and seal
validation_rules: TC number present; date of leaving not in the future; name and date of birth match application; signature and seal present
common_errors: Duplicate TC without 'duplicate' note; no seal; date of birth mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Verification by the issuing institution
corrective_action: Request correction or a duplicate from the institution
notes: Not always needed for scholarships - check scheme

document_purpose: Needed when moving between universities or boards
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Name; registration number; university or board; course; year of passing; date; signature
validation_rules: Registration number present; course stated; date valid; name matches application
common_errors: Migration certificate requested before result declared; name mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the portal
issuing_authority: University or board of previous study
official_verification_method: Verification by issuing university or board
corrective_action: Apply to the previous university or board
notes: Rarely needed for scholarship stage - confirm requirement

document_name: Entrance exam rank card / scorecard (e.g. KCET)
document_purpose: Proof of rank for admission-linked scholarships and seat allotment

validation_rules: Registration number present; exam year matches; name matches application; rank numeric
common_errors: Previous year's scorecard; rank for another exam; name mismatch
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to the exam year
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal
issuing_authority: Karnataka Examinations Authority (for KCET; varies by exam)
official_verification_method: Official exam authority portal

notes: Confirm the current KEA portal address before use

document_purpose: Proof that the student lives in a hostel, relevant for hosteller rates of some scholarships
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines

validation_rules: Hostel name present; period stated; signature and seal present; name matches application
common_errors: No period stated; unsigned; private PG receipt used where institutional hostel is required
expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to academic year
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal
official_verification_method: Institute verification
corrective_action: Request an updated certificate with period and seal
notes: Whether a private PG counts differs by scheme

document_purpose: Proof of date and place of birth; used to support domicile claims
related_scheme_or_use_case: Used for date of birth proof - varies by scheme
required_fields: Child name; date of birth; place of birth; parents' names; registration number; date of registration; registrar
validation_rules: Registration number present; date of birth matches other documents; parents' names match records; registrar sign or QR
common_errors: Name not entered at birth; date mismatch with school record; late registration issues
expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the scheme portal

official_verification_method: State civil registration portal or CRS (confirm)

document_purpose: Proof of Kannada-medium schooling for reservation in specific courses
related_scheme_or_use_case: Scholarship/scheme applications (e.g. NSP, Karnataka SSP); exact requirement varies by scheme - check scheme guidelines
required_fields: Student name; years studied in Kannada medium; school names; head of institution signature and seal; date
validation_rules: Years of study stated; school names listed; signature and seal present; name matches application

expiry_or_validity_rule: Does not expire; scheme-specific

document_purpose: Proof of belonging to the region for local-area reservation

expiry_or_validity_rule: Varies - confirm in current government order
accepted_format: PDF - confirm with the portal
official_verification_method: Verify certificate number on Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri (confirm)
corrective_action: Apply for a fresh certificate through the revenue office
notes: Eligibility rules are defined by government orders and may change

document_purpose: Supporting evidence for a residential address
related_scheme_or_use_case: varies by scheme

validation_rules: Tax year recent; address matches application; owner is applicant or family member; receipt number present
common_errors: Receipt for a different property; owner is different and no relationship shown; old receipt
expiry_or_validity_rule: Depends on tax year
accepted_format: PDF or image - confirm with the scheme portal

official_verification_method: Verification on the local body's portal (varies)

notes: Acceptance as address proof is scheme-specific

accepted_format: PDF or image of first page - confirm with the portal

expiry_or_validity_rule: No expiry; account must be active

expiry_or_validity_rule: Applies to a specific period

notes: Treat as highly sensitive; avoid storing full statements
